newsitem.title: TURKEY: ISTANBUL GOLD VOLUME DROPS AS PRICES RISE SHARPLY.
newsitem.headline: ISTANBUL GOLD VOLUME DROPS AS PRICES RISE SHARPLY.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange dropped to 1,135 kg on Monday from Friday's 1,829 kg as prices rose sharply in line with international markets, dealers said.
Gold jumped to $328.00 an ounce and 1,733,600 lira per gram, from $323.10 and 1,700,300 lira at Friday's close.
Dealers said higher prices caused buyers to take to the sidelines to await developments in world gold markets.
The Turkish lira eased to 163,350 against the dollar from Friday's 163,010 close on the high cost of funding in the domestic market, causing gold prices in lira terms to rise further.
The bulk of the day's trade -- 700 kg -- was done in the afternoon session and 55.5 percent of the total was conducted in dollar terms.
